leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempt to fit the pen-lift lever was unproductive because it could not be fitted yet.

surprise.text: The drawing test revealed that a small difference in motor speeds made the rover curve, and that the receiver could be trimmed to correct it.

arbitrary.text: The lever's purpose was clear, but needing the straight-line test before fitting it felt somewhat arbitrary; the failed attempt did not explain why.
